description.p: Hyper PDF Viewer is a fast PDF viewer that opens every document as a tab in one window. It renders with HyperPDF, follows your KDE colour scheme and integrates with Dolphin: opening files from the file manager adds tabs to the running window and opened documents appear in Recent Files.

ul.li: Tabs with session restore, reordering and reopening of closed tabs
Continuous single, dual and book layouts with fit width, fit page and free zoom
Thumbnails, outline and search results sidebar
Find with match case and whole words, text selection and copy
Night mode, rotation, history and page labels
